notes2024: No archived mid-2024 edition could be retrieved (mn.gov serves only the current file; web.archive.org was rate-limited/offline during this run). Values are derived from the CURRENT schedule (AS OF 10/12/2026) using its 'EFF DATE' column, which the document defines as 'the effective date of the current TOTAL ALLOWABLE': only codes whose current total allowable has an effective date on or before 2024-07-01 are included (that amount was therefore already in force on 2024-07-01). Excluded because the current amount took effect after 2024-07-01 (2024 value unknown): D6010(eff 2025-01-01), D7140(eff 2026-10-01), D7210(eff 2026-10-01), D7220(eff 2026-10-01), D7230(eff 2026-10-01), D7240(eff 2026-10-01), D7241(eff 2026-10-01), D7250(eff 2026-10-01).
